name: UIExecutionAgent
description: Runs generated TypeScript Playwright .spec.ts files (or legacy pytest .py files) via subprocess, streams progress, handles browser-close/headless-switch heuristics, and returns a flat per-test results list. Phase 0: base URL resolved explicitly or the run fails fast (blocking) — no localhost fallback; runs spanning modules with different URLs are split per module; MTA_ALLOWED_HOSTS is passed to the runtime host guard; a normalised execution_results v2 record is written to reports/mta/. Phase 1: each result records Playwright's raw pw_status, tags and annotations (tc_id / ac_ids); every run (including healing re-runs) is folded into test_creation/traceability.json when requirements.enabled is on — never fatal. Phase 4: Playwright 1.64 runtime — projects from execution.matrix, --output in its own test-results folder, JUnit + MTA reporter outputs (TC/AC-linked per-test results), grep / suite-by-grep, local shards + merge-reports and CI shard/merge_run, and a per-role storage-state pre-step (execution.role_auth) for test.use({ role }).

inputs.name: module_filter
inputs.description: Scope execution to one module's specs

inputs.name: safety
inputs.description: Resolved SafetyPolicy (allowed_hosts -> MTA_ALLOWED_HOSTS); derived from project.yaml when absent

inputs.name: execution
inputs.description: Resolved project.yaml execution: block (tools/execution/config.py); derived from project.yaml when absent

inputs.name: browsers
inputs.description: Override the matrix: chromium | firefox | webkit | pixel-7 | iphone-14

inputs.name: shards
inputs.description: Run N local shards and merge them (execution.shards by default)

inputs.name: shard
inputs.description: Run one shard i/n (CI job) and write its blob report

inputs.name: run_id
inputs.description: Shared run id of a CI run's shards (reports/blob/<run_id>/)

inputs.name: merge_run
inputs.description: Merge reports/blob/<run_id>/ instead of running tests

outputs.name: traceability_json
outputs.description: test_creation/traceability.json latest_result per test case (requirements.enabled only)

outputs.name: report_json
outputs.description: Path to the Playwright JSON report

outputs.name: run_errors
outputs.description: Errors of failed sub-runs when a run was split per module

outputs.name: role_auth
outputs.description: Per-role storage-state summary {dir, roles[{name, strategy, status, path?, error?}], failed[]} (execution.role_auth)
